Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1 TENDER ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: [a] The bidder with past performance of satisfactory execution of contracts to SC Railway/Other Zon al Railways/PUs/Central Govt/State Govt/PSUs for supply of the same / similar items for a quantity of 1 Number or more of tendered quantity against a single contract during last three years prior to, and excluding tender opening date shall be considered as responsive to SC Railways requirements for pl acement of bulk and regular order. bidders are requested to submit the past performance report suc h as Copies of R Notes/CRAC/Proof of acceptance of material by consignee etc. along with their offer; failing which offer will be summarily rejected without making any back reference. SIMILAR ITEM: Any Capacity/Type of Forklift [b] In case, the bidder participates as an authorized dealer, then the performance as required above shall be that of Principal (OEM) authorizing the agent or bidder for the same OEM. It may so happen t hat the agent/dealer has credentials of past supply for a different Principal/OEM, then it will not be co nsidered as performance. For Authorised dealers, tender specific authorization from OEM has to be u ploaded with bid. 2 Clause wise compliance of the tendered specifications attached must be submitted along with the bi d duly signed by the bidders. Failure to do so will result in summary rejection of the offer. 3 Minor deviations from tendered specifications shall be acceptable subject to such deviations does no t adversely affect the performance of the machine in intended use.

4 Payment Terms: The standard payment terms subject to recoveries, if any, under the liquidated damages clause and general condition of contract will be as under:- 100% payment will be made after receipt, installation/commissioning and acceptance of the material by the consignee. Note: Bill passing officer to ensure the validity of PBG/WSD to cover wa rranty obligations as per contract before passing final bill. 5 Other conditions: 6 Penalty Clause: 1. After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 7 days time limit (or as specified in other terms in contract). 2. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification within the defined time limit, a penalty of 0 .5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the se ller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to r ecover all such shall be charged as penalty or recover all such penalty amount from the Warra nty Performance Security (WPBG) for each week of delay from the seller. 3. Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 5% of the total contract value after which the B uyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the ri sk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of WPBG. Seller shall be liable to reimburse the cos t of such service /get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cos t of the Seller besides forfeiture of WPBG. Seller shall be liable to reimburse the cost of such s ervice / rectification to the Buyer. 4. Bad performance in supply/warranty obligations etc. in this contract shall be recorded and dul y taken into consideration while taking decision in future tenders issued from Indian Railways. Bad performance shall include, but not limited to, failure to honour timelines/ conditions specif ied in contract, PO cancellation on suppliers account, repeated DP extension, poor warranty/A MC support etc. 7 Consignee Details (For delivery and payment matters): Mr. PAVAN KUMAR KALYANAM SSE/Stores/COA Office of ADME/C&W/COA Near Suryanarayanapuram Railway Gate, Running Room/COA, New Port Railway station, Kakinada 53 3001 Contact No.: : 9701373457, E-Mail: ssestorechg_coascor@gmail.com: admecnwcoascor@gmail.com: srdmeb zascor@gmail.com Special Conditions:

OEM Warranty certificates must be subm itted by the contractor at the time of delivery of Goods. 5 EMD : Offers submitted without applicable EMD shall be summarily rejected. Railways have the Righ t to forfeit the Earnest Money Deposit if the bidder withdraws or revises his offer within the offer vali dity period. PBG may be submitt ed in the form of FDR/BG etc. 2. If the successful bidder does not deposit the PBG amount within stipulated time, then EMD sh all be forfeited and case will be dealt with as that of withdrawal of offer by the bidder as per e xtant instructions. 3. Howeve r, quoting unreasonably long delivery period compared to the tendered delivery schedule may result in disqualification of the offer. 9 General Damages: Wherever PBG has been exempted for any reason and the supplier fails to supply goods as per conditions of the contract, as amended from time to time, Purchaser shall have the righ t to cancel the Purchase Order with General Damages @ 5 % of the contract value, not by way of pe nalty.
